quirks.summary: File GETs require a Referer header set to the documents-tab URL, as at RBWM.
quirks.workaround: Send the documents-tab URL as Referer on every file GET, as Recipe C step 5 does.

quirks.summary: The advanced search offers no 'application received' date filter; use date(applicationValidatedStart/End) instead.
quirks.detail: Posting date(applicationReceivedStart) to an install that does not offer it returns HTTP 500, which reads as a portal fault rather than a bad parameter. Fields present: appealDecision, applicationCommittee, applicationDecision, applicationValidated.
quirks.workaround: Read the date field names off the advanced search form before posting.

source_notes: Idox. Also requires Referer on file GET (same as RBWM).
